name: Petrov Defense
description: A calm opening course that teaches symmetry, development, and avoiding early tactical mistakes against 2...Nf6.

branches.title: Main Line: Meet Nf6 Calmly
branches.description: Learn the Petrov starting position and a safe central response.

moves.title: Start with e4
moves.explanation: Control the center. e4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Petrov is calm: avoid pawn traps, develop, castle, and use trades to simplify only when your pieces are ready.

moves.title: Black mirrors

moves.title: Develop
moves.explanation: Attack e5. Nf3 develops a knight to f3. Developed pieces control central squares, help castling, and make future tactics possible without forcing anything too early.

moves.title: Petrov Defense
